fluency: Human review of sentence formation only: 0 predominantly malformed fragments; 1 mixed readable and malformed constructions; 2 predominantly readable grammatical sentences. Do not infer correctness or relevance from fluency.
coherence: Human review of internal continuity: 0 disconnected or looping; 1 partially connected with repetition or contradictions; 2 a consistent connected response. Score separately from factual correctness.
relevance: Human review: 0 does not address the request; 1 partly addresses it; 2 directly addresses it.
correctness: Exact checks or restricted fixed tests when specified; otherwise human review.
instruction_following: Exact requested format where checked; otherwise human review.
repetition: Mean per-response fraction of repeated word four-grams; descriptive only, not a fluency score.
generation: Report truncation, response length and empty responses separately; ending before the token limit is not proof of a complete answer.
task_success: Only measured for defined deterministic tasks; null is unmeasured.
scale: Human review 0=not met, 1=partial, 2=met. Never manufacture human ratings. Keep unreviewed values null and report their coverage.
limitations: 36 fixed repeated prompts; small single-seed cohort. No combined intelligence score. No training on these prompts or feedback.
